Evidence Summary: C3 AI agents execute multi-step database queries, analyze information, surface insights, and orchestrate enterprise workflows autonomously. They dynamically generate and run Python scripts in real time while leveraging error self-correction and reflection mechanisms to refine outputs without manual intervention.
Evaluation Notes: Uses automated reflection loops, tool selection, and dynamic script generation to execute multi-step workflows against enterprise systems.

Evidence Summary: Dynamic multi-hop orchestration agents utilize step-by-step reasoning (inspired by Demonstrate-Search-Predict / Read-Extract-Answer frameworks) to interpret queries, select tools, retrieve context, and execute tasks across multiple iterative hops.
Evaluation Notes: Supports iterative multi-step reasoning, dynamic tool selection, and context retrieval over complex, heterogeneous data.

Evidence Summary: C3 Agentic AI Platform provides Agentic Process Automation (APA) and Agentic Workflows over C3 AI Object Models. It connects data sources, ML models, and business logic into directed graph workflows and self-executing decision chains triggered on schedule, on demand, or by data events.
Evaluation Notes: Enables graph-based workflow definition, scheduled/event-driven task orchestration, and structured data retrieval pipelines.

Evidence Summary: Uses vector-store RAG combined with long-term memory to maintain domain-specific context, atomic tasks, and few-shot examples. Short-term conversational context is preserved within active and recent user sessions.
Evaluation Notes: Merges vector retrieval with persistent few-shot example memory. Public docs emphasize session-level context, while persistent long-term memory leverages domain stores.

Evidence Summary: Employs an evaluation framework with three feedback loops (automated ML metrics, ground-truth comparison, LLM self-grading with human calibration). The STAFF framework distills operational history into fine-tuned agents, while few-shot examples guide in-context adaptation.
Evaluation Notes: Combines three-tiered evaluation loops and agent distillation with configurable in-context few-shot learning.

Evidence Summary: C3 AI's STAFF framework and C3 Generative AI architecture orchestrate specialized agents (process extraction, generators, critics, tool users) structured as directed graphs, using a central orchestrator to coordinate tools, models, and decision nodes.
Evaluation Notes: Multi-agent interaction is modeled as directed graph topologies of specialized agents coordinated via a central orchestrator.

Evidence Summary: C3 AI Studio provides a graphical Application Canvas and visual UI where users can construct dashboards, configure workflows, management/delete, and interactively test agents using natural language or by cloning templates (e.g., Dynamic, Canvas, Deep Research agents).
Evaluation Notes: Features low-code Application Canvas, template duplication, and visual data pipeline design tools.

Evidence Summary: Standardized LLM client interface supports commercial models (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI/PaLM/Gemini, Claude), open-source models (Llama, Mistral, Falcon, FLAN-T5), and custom fine-tuned enterprise models without altering application logic.
Evaluation Notes: Allows switching underlying LLM providers and models seamlessly via a standardized client abstraction.

Evidence Summary: Features C3 Code (a natural-language development environment), native VS Code extensions, managed JupyterLab services with pre-written code blocks, pre-built domain templates, and reusable tools/components to streamline agent development.
Evaluation Notes: Comprehensive developer tooling combining visual low-code managers with IDE extensions and sample code libraries.

Evidence Summary: C3 AI Studio, Data Fusion, and custom agent tools integrate with enterprise systems (SAP, ERP, CRM, SCADA, sensor data) using REST APIs, C3 AI Type System object models, pre-built connectors, and cloud storage/database access tools.
Evaluation Notes: Uses C3 Type System and Data Fusion visual connectors for seamless enterprise system integration.

Evidence Summary: Agents deploy as C3 AI-managed or customer-managed cloud services across AWS (including AWS GovCloud and ICMP Marketplace), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or on-premises/air-gapped FedRAMP environments using Kubernetes (RKE2/OpenShift).
Evaluation Notes: Highly flexible deployment footprint supporting multicloud, hybrid, on-premises Kubernetes, and air-gapped government clouds.

Evidence Summary: Supports interactive execution with human verification and approval checkpoints (e.g., turbine-monitoring workflows routing drafted work orders to schedulers for approval before execution).
Evaluation Notes: Built-in interactive checkpoints allow explicit human review steps within complex automated agent workflows.

Evidence Summary: Agent Workbench delivers execution trace visibility into reasoning chains and step-level callbacks. The platform provides source data citations, interactive chat verification, visual data lineage, model explainability, and config auditing (users, timestamps, actions).
Evaluation Notes: Combines exact source attribution and visual data lineage with operational trace visibility and configuration auditing.

Evidence Summary: Enforces multi-level authentication (OIDC, SAML, OAuth 2.0) and dynamic, programmatically settable row-level authorization for data objects/methods using RBAC, SOC/FedRAMP compliant audit trails, and config change auditing.
Evaluation Notes: Enterprise-grade security featuring row-level authorization, compliance audit logs, and modern SSO protocol support.

Evidence Summary: Model-driven Type System architecture handles petabyte-scale data ingestion and manages operations from single models up to millions of deployed models, utilizing elastic compute, dedicated compute pools, and Kubernetes cluster orchestration to handle concurrent requests automatically.
Evaluation Notes: Scales automatically across Kubernetes infrastructure with dedicated compute pools and dev/test/prod environment isolation.

Evidence Summary: Offers over 40 pre-built enterprise applications and generative AI solutions spanning Defense & Intelligence, Manufacturing, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Healthcare, Supply Chain, and Financial Services.
Evaluation Notes: Extensive pre-built operational applications and domain algorithms validated across diverse global industries.

Evidence Summary: Documented real-world impacts include US Marine Corps decision optimization, asset inspection acceleration, a 55% improvement in lead-time prediction for a global retailer, and a 2.8% revenue uplift for a contract manufacturer, with initial production deployment in 6 months.
Source Type: Customer case studies and implementation stories
Evaluation Notes: Demonstrates quantifiable customer ROI and operational improvements, though results are customer-reported.
